design-brief.instructions: REPLICA ESATTA reference 11.04.37 - 'Come Essere Costante'. Pink full background con foto stock donna fitness in basso, testo white sopra, header Zoom + WEBINAR GRATUITO, pill data. Topic: stesso del webinar (costanza).

element.font: Zoom Sans Bold (or fallback Inter Bold)
element.icon: zoom video camera icon left of text

text-block.line: 3 step per ottenere la migliore forma fisica

photo-asset.subject: Donna 35-50 anni, vista dorsale o tre quarti, mid-curl con manubrio piccolo, top sportivo neutro, sfondo neutro chiaro/grigio, faccia non visibile o parzialmente nascosta. Atletica ma reale (NO fitness model esagerata).
photo-asset.treatment: Foto stock professionale OPPURE generata con AI (vedi prompt sotto). Edit: ritagliata su sfondo neutro, leggera grain, NON saturated.

or-generate-with-ai.prompt: A real woman aged 40-50 with shoulder-length dark hair, photographed from behind in a three-quarter angle, holding a small dumbbell mid-bicep curl. Wearing a simple dark athletic top. Natural light, clean light grey/cream studio background. Photorealistic, soft documentary lifestyle photography, real body type (not fitness model), focused expression visible in profile only. No face directly to camera. Mood: capable, focused, real woman.
or-generate-with-ai.negative-prompt: fitness influencer, model, perfect body, oily skin, gym posing, fake smile, photoshopped, instagram filter, oversaturated
